article.title: The American people have spoken, and across the political spectrum they don’t like Israel
article.author: Philip Weiss
article.content: “Everyone knows why we lost,” J.D. Vance said after the Republican wipeout in the midterm elections, and among the reasons he cited was Israel. For decades, the Israel lobby worked to keep Zionism’s bigotry off voters’ radar. Those days are over.
